description: Na₃Sr₃AlP₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃mc space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.24 Å. Sr is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Al and six P atoms. The Sr-Al bond length is 3.25 Å. There are a spread of Sr-P bond distances ranging from 3.11-3.49 Å. Al is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to three equivalent Sr and four P atoms. There are three shorter (2.42 Å) and one longer (2.49 Å) Al-P bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, six equivalent Sr, and one Al atom. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, four equivalent Sr, and one Al atom.
